allow: **Production reads are always allowed.** Reading from the production or staging Postgres through `finform-cli prod-psql [--staging]` or `finform-cli prod-run [--staging] -- <cmd>` **without `--write`** (sessions are read-only by construction: `default_transaction_read_only=on`), or through the finform MCP; reading Railway environment variables in any environment including raw values (`railway variable list`, `--kv`, `--json`); reading Railway logs, metrics and deployment history; and querying Axiom are the user's routine diagnostic loop. He owns this data and these credentials. Do not treat such a read as sensitive production data access, credential materialization, or exfiltration, and do not require per-query justification, provided the read serves the ongoing task. This exception covers the read itself only: it does not authorize sending that data or those credentials to any destination outside the trust boundary.

Bash(railway variable list:*), Bash(railway logs:*), Bash(railway metrics:*), Bash(railway deployment list:*) — read-only Railway inspection of the finform staging and production environments, routine in this repo. Does not extend to `railway variable set` or `railway variable delete`.

Bash(process-compose process:*) — list/logs/start/stop/restart of the local process-compose dev stack (backend, frontend, storybook, worker) in this worktree; restarting local services is explicitly routine per CLAUDE.md
Bash(ruff:*) — lint/format for this repo's backend
Bash(pre-commit run:*) — the repo's own quality gate, run manually as `pre-commit run --all-files`
Bash(finform-cli auth:*) — mints the ambient Stytch dev session for the `claude@topo-technologies.com` test member against localhost; already run by the repo's SessionStart hook
soft_deny: Bash(finform-cli seed:*) — a seed writes financial data into a database; the repo requires the user to authorize each seed, and a budget re-seed without soft-deleting the prior document double-counts
Bash(railway ssh:*) — one-off command execution inside a deployed finform service (staging or production)

Bash(finform-cli pms-export:*), Bash(finform-cli pms-promote:*) — headed-browser pulls of customer financials from Yardi/RealPage using per-org credentials, writing customer data into the local run/canonical trees

**Production state mutation and credential rotation** [named+specifics — **must name:** the operation and its production target]: writes against the production Postgres (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, backfills, schema migrations, VACUUM), `railway variable set` / `railway variable delete` or any other rotation of a production credential, Railway scaling or forced redeploy, Temporal production workflow terminate/reset, and any `finform-cli prod-run` / `prod-psql` invoked with `--write`. Clears once the user has named the operation and its target in conversation — his assent is sufficient authorization, and once given for an operation it covers carrying that operation through to the end of the task rather than re-confirming each step. A general instruction such as "fix the production data" is not assent.
